segments.sn35.114:1.1: “Santi, bhikkhave, cakkhuviññeyyā rūpā, iṭṭhā kantā manāpā piyarūpā kāmūpasaṃhitā rajanīyā.
segments.sn35.114:1.2: Tañce, bhikkhu, abhinandati abhivadati ajjhosāya tiṭṭhati –
segments.sn35.114:1.3: ayaṃ vuccati, bhikkhave, bhikkhu āvāsagato mārassa, mārassa vasaṃ gato [vasagato (sī. aṭṭha. syā. aṭṭha.)], paṭimukkassa mārapāso.
segments.sn35.114:2.1: “Santi, bhikkhave, jivhāviññeyyā rasā, iṭṭhā kantā manāpā piyarūpā kāmūpasaṃhitā rajanīyā.
segments.sn35.114:2.2: Tañce bhikkhu abhinandati abhivadati ajjhosāya tiṭṭhati –
segments.sn35.114:2.3: ayaṃ vuccati, bhikkhave, bhikkhu āvāsagato mārassa, mārassa vasaṃ gato, paṭimukkassa mārapāso. Baddho so mārabandhanena…pe….
segments.sn35.114:3.1: “Santi, bhikkhave, manoviññeyyā dhammā, iṭṭhā kantā manāpā piyarūpā kāmūpasaṃhitā rajanīyā.
segments.sn35.114:3.2: Tañce bhikkhu abhinandati abhivadati ajjhosāya tiṭṭhati –
segments.sn35.114:3.3: ayaṃ vuccati, bhikkhave, bhikkhu āvāsagato mārassa, mārassa vasaṃ gato, paṭimukkassa mārapāso.
segments.sn35.114:4.1: “Santi ca kho, bhikkhave, cakkhuviññeyyā rūpā, iṭṭhā kantā manāpā piyarūpā kāmūpasaṃhitā rajanīyā.
segments.sn35.114:4.2: Tañce bhikkhu nābhinandati nābhivadati nājjhosāya tiṭṭhati –
segments.sn35.114:4.3: ayaṃ vuccati, bhikkhave, bhikkhu nāvāsagato mārassa, na mārassa vasaṃ gato, ummukkassa mārapāso.
segments.sn35.114:4.4: Mutto so mārabandhanena na yathākāmakaraṇīyo pāpimato…pe….
segments.sn35.114:5.1: “Santi, bhikkhave, jivhāviññeyyā rasā, iṭṭhā kantā manāpā piyarūpā kāmūpasaṃhitā rajanīyā.
segments.sn35.114:5.2: Tañce bhikkhu nābhinandati nābhivadati nājjhosāya tiṭṭhati –
segments.sn35.114:5.3: ayaṃ vuccati, bhikkhave, bhikkhu nāvāsagato mārassa, na mārassa vasaṃ gato, ummukkassa mārapāso. Mutto so mārabandhanena na yathākāmakaraṇīyo pāpimato…pe….
segments.sn35.114:6.1: “Santi, bhikkhave, manoviññeyyā dhammā, iṭṭhā kantā manāpā piyarūpā kāmūpasaṃhitā rajanīyā.
segments.sn35.114:6.2: Tañce bhikkhu nābhinandati nābhivadati nājjhosāya tiṭṭhati –
segments.sn35.114:6.3: ayaṃ vuccati, bhikkhave, bhikkhu nāvāsagato mārassa, na mārassa vasaṃ gato, ummukkassa mārapāso.
segments.sn35.114:6.4: Mutto so mārabandhanena na yathākāmakaraṇīyo pāpimato”ti.

lines: Mārassa vasaṃ gatoti tividhassāpi mārassa vasaṃ gato.
Paṭimukka’ssa mārapāsoti assa gīvāya mārapāso paṭimukko pavesito.
Tato eva devaputtamārassapi vasaṃ gatoti sakkā viññātuṃ.
